_comment: composites import-captures framing-classification threshold (#256). The tournament-caps corpus spans TWO PHYSICALLY DIFFERENT rigs (Calling Edinburgh World Tour, 37 files, batch timestamped 13:22-13:26; Pro Tour Las Vegas, 23 files, batch timestamped 16:22-16:24 -- distinct mat color/chrome palette, same structural layout) -- this ONE threshold was explicitly re-verified against BOTH independently, not just the first rig found. Calling Edinburgh: full-broadcast aspect ratio in [1.745, 1.791] across 20 files, play-area-crop in [1.158, 1.189] across 17 files. Pro Tour Las Vegas: full-broadcast aspect ratio in [1.759, 1.800] across 12 files, play-area-crop in [1.153, 1.174] across 11 files. Both rigs' clusters sit comfortably on either side of 1.4 with large margin -- the same threshold generalizes across rigs because both broadcast productions use the same real-world camera framing convention (full frame vs. play-area-only crop), not because of any rig-specific tuning. See src/composites/importCaptures.ts's classifyFraming for the (inclusive-at-threshold) comparison.
